visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair, wearing dark sunglasses and a black-and-white checkered short-sleeved shirt, stands outdoors in front of a large market structure. A prominent green neon sign in Thai is visible above him, and several silver cars and a white van are parked in the background. (2) The scene shifts indoors to a brightly lit seafood market. Close-up shots display scallops on red trays, skewers of small white squid, and large prawns on ice, all labeled with yellow price tags. (3) The man is now seated at a stainless steel table within the market restaurant. He uses chopsticks to lift a large piece of meat from a grilled prawn. Spread on the table are plates of crab fried rice, stir-fried clams, and grilled scallops in their shells. (4) Shots of other market sections follow, showing stalls filled with rows of bright oranges and green watermelons under warm yellow lighting. (5) The man continues eating the prawns and fried rice, showing expressions of delight. Background figures move through the market aisles behind him, and various food stalls with colorful signage are visible.
